verdict.rationale: GrowthBook clearly delivers official SDKs. The GitHub repo lists 24 SDKs, and first-party docs cover JS, React/React Native, Vue, Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, a script tag, and edge (Cloudflare). All SDKs share the same assignment logic and a 400+ test language-agnostic suite. Community users report wiring up flags in about 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code, and getting flags plus A/B tests into a Vue frontend in a few hours. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration across the non-JS SDKs (mobile/server), and evidence on SDK versioning and maintenance.
